scene.ko: 커트가 생각보다 훨씬 짧게 나와 센티미터와 인치를 잘못 알아들은 것을 알게 되고, 정중히 불만을 말해 고칠 방법을 정한다.

lines.en: And we're done! How do you like it?
Um, I hate to say this, but it's a lot shorter than I expected.
lines.ko: 음, 이런 말씀 드리기 좀 그런데요, 생각했던 것보다 훨씬 짧아요.
alt: Hmm, I'm sorry, but it's much shorter than I wanted.
Well, it's a lot shorter than I thought it would be.

lines.en: Really? You asked me to take off about four inches, right?
Oh no, I think there's been a misunderstanding. I meant four centimeters, not four inches.
lines.ko: 아, 이런. 오해가 있었던 것 같아요. 4인치가 아니라 4센티미터를 말한 거였어요.
alt: Oh, I think we misunderstood each other. I said four centimeters, not inches.
Oh no. I meant four centimeters. In Korea, we use centimeters.

lines.en: Oh, I'm so sorry! Four inches is about ten centimeters. I should have double-checked with you.
lines.ko: 어머, 정말 죄송해요! 4인치면 10센티미터쯤이에요. 제가 다시 확인했어야 했는데요.

lines.en: It's partly my fault, too. Is there anything you can do to make it look more even? The left side looks a bit longer.
lines.ko: 제 잘못도 있어요. 좀 더 고르게 보이게 해 주실 수 있을까요? 왼쪽이 조금 더 길어 보여요.
alt: It's not all your fault. Could you even it out? The left side seems longer.
That's okay, I should have been clearer. Could you make both sides even? The left looks longer.

lines.en: Absolutely. I'll even it out and add some soft layers so it looks fuller.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 길이를 맞추고 부드럽게 층을 내서 더 풍성해 보이게 해 드릴게요.

lines.en: That sounds good. Would you mind not taking off any more length, though?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그래도 길이는 더 자르지 말아 주시겠어요?
alt: Okay. But please don't make it any shorter.
Sounds good. Could you try not to cut off any more length?

lines.en: Of course. And since this was my mistake, today's cut is on the house.
lines.ko: 물론이에요. 그리고 제 실수였으니까 오늘 커트는 무료로 해 드릴게요.

lines.en: That's really kind of you. Thanks for being so understanding.
alt: That's very kind. Thank you for understanding.
You're very kind. Thanks for being so nice about it.

expressions.en: It's a lot shorter than I expected.
expressions.note: 기대와 다를 때 · ___er than I expected

expressions.en: I think there's been a misunderstanding.
expressions.note: 상대를 탓하지 않고 문제를 꺼낼 때
하지 말아 달라고 공손하게 부탁할 때
